- Fixed half-time and triplet tempo errors and timed short and seamless loops with the learned tempo model ([#116](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/116), [#139](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/139), [#147](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/147), [#169](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/169)).
- Clip lengths under one second show in tenths ([#109](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/109)), and short-clip timbre measurements and saved character corrections are fixed ([#190](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/190)).
- Fixed audio evidence, graph filters and shared workspace navigation ([#158](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/158)), and saved audio filters, warnings and analysis notes survive the clip-panel redesign ([#179](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/179)).
- Production fixes: real 404 pages, asset caching, reload after deploys and the phone welcome card ([#181](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/181)). The 2D/3D toggle no longer reads as one merged button ([#159](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/159)).
- A new run's preview can replace a cancelled analysis, so the panel no longer sticks on "Analysis: cancelled" ([#257](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/257)).
- Fixed a synthesizer event tag and stale single-thread fallback found in review ([#100](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/100)).
- Fewer wrong sound tags: instruments that play in only part of a song are kept ([#97](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/97)), tested tags stay visible over untested ones ([#106](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/106)), synth and drum tags show on dubstep and electro house ([#113](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/113)), pads are no longer tagged as voice ([#136](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/136)), false cello and trumpet tags are cut ([#132](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/132)), and threshold handling is fixed ([#163](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/163)).
- Sound tags are more accurate after retrains and blends: full-mix OpenMIC instrument heads ([#134](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/134)), retrained DJ effect heads ([#167](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/167)), best-run blends and newer tagger rounds ([#175](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/175), [#216](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/216), [#228](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/228)), calibrated heads ([#191](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/191)), 12 clean-retrained detectors ([#232](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/232)), a refit trumpet head ([#250](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/250)), and electric guitar and piano checked by the tagger on short notes ([#259](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/259)).
- Tag cutoffs tuned so tags show when they should: every tag clearing 50% precision and recall shows normally ([#193](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/193)), percussion shows more often ([#227](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/227)), and trumpet, downlifter and voice show only when the tagger is sure ([#231](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/231), [#233](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/233), [#243](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/243)).
- The trained instrument detector runs on songs again, and AST runs on the graphics card where no validated scorer reads its scores ([#104](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/104), [#105](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/105)).

### Security
- Updated `electron` to 43.8.4 (exact pin). Includes the GHSA-jr5w-w6x2-84p9 mitigation for compromised eMudhra intermediate certificates, plus the 43.8.4 File System Access blocklist fixes and the ICU tzdata 2026e update. ([#253](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/253))
- Dev-only lockfile patches, staying on the same major the parents already allow: `undici` 7.30.0 → 7.30.1 and the nested `node-gyp` copy 6.29.0 → 6.29.1, `brace-expansion` 1.1.15 → 1.1.21, `fast-uri` 3.1.8 → 3.1.9, and `vitest` / `@vitest/mocker` 4.1.11 → 4.1.12. ([#253](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/253))
- Updated `pdfjs-dist` to 6.4.299 (fixes GHSA-hq66-cqwq-w95j, arbitrary JavaScript execution when opening a malicious PDF), `electron` to 43.7.7 (sandbox-inheritance and protocol-handler advisories), and `vitest` to 4.1.11 (`@vitest/mocker` path traversal). ([#87](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/87))
- `@huggingface/transformers` 4.2.0 → 4.3.0 together with its coupled `onnxruntime-web` pin (1.26.0-dev → 1.31.0-dev.20260914); the two must move as a pair or the bundle ends up with two ONNX runtimes. Pulls in patched `sharp` 0.35 and `onnxruntime-node` 1.30 (clears the libvips/libheif and adm-zip advisories). Verified end to end in the browser: demo-corpus embeddings and local audio inference both run on the new runtime, and the air-gap sanitizer still finds zero external hosts. ([#87](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/87))
- `openai` is now a devDependency: it is used only by the dev-server-only DJ assistant plugins and no longer sits in the production dependency tree. ([#87](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/87))
- `.dockerignore` excludes `.env*` so a local `OPENAI_API_KEY` can never be copied into a Docker build layer. ([#87](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/87))
- SECURITY.md documents the `npm run dev`-only OpenAI side channel (sound search, voice transcription, sample review) and the local Python reviewer it spawns, and clarifies that no built artifact includes it. ([#87](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/87))
- Hardened enrichment and subagent guards ([#25](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/25)), and annotation records are size-limited where they cross trust boundaries ([#40](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/40)).

### Internal
- Dependabot: GitHub Actions `actions/checkout` and `actions/setup-node` 4 → 7 ([#42](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/42), [#43](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/43)).
- Dependabot: dev tooling, including the dev-dependencies group, `jsdom` 29 → 30, `vite-node` 3 → 6 and `@eslint/js` 9 → 10 ([#44](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/44), [#46](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/46), [#47](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/47), [#48](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/48)).
- Dependabot: production minor and patch group, 7 updates ([#45](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/45)).
- Took the remaining three Dependabot updates with the fixes they needed ([#212](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/212)).
- CI: e2e tests get a 60s action budget and run as four parallel jobs ([#98](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/98), [#133](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/133)), every push to main is tested and the Docker image builds from cached weights ([#166](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/166)), the slow graph-accuracy test runs on its own machine ([#203](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/203)), docs- or Python-only PRs skip browser tests and Docker ([#204](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/204)), and CodeRabbit reviews every target branch ([#177](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/177)).
- Accuracy gate so held-out tag, tempo and key numbers can't drop ([#124](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/124)), checked one merge at a time on main with one 18-job round per PR ([#202](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/202)), kept up through Jamendo CDN 503s ([#256](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/256)), and with held-out audio kept out of public run artifacts ([#261](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/261)).
